name: wayfinder
description: Retrieve and insert for notes and docs: which notes answer this, and where new text belongs. Needs the wayfinder CLI (uv tool install).

interface.shortDescription: Find notes and where new text belongs
interface.longDescription: Read-only retrieve and insert tools over a folder of markdown notes, with an eval that picks the ranking method from your own history.
